translation.title: Piroxicam Gel
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for pain relief and anti-inflammation in degenerative arthritis (osteoarthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (tennis elbow, etc.), muscle pain (myositis, fasciitis, etc.), and post-traumatic swelling and pain.
translation.usage: Adults: apply about 3 cm (1 g) thinly to the affected area 3 to 4 times a day and rub in gently so it absorbs well.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or to piroxicam preparations, if you have or have had aspirin-induced asthma (asthma attacks caused by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, etc.), for children 14 years and under, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, or if you are breastfeeding. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, if you are hypersensitive to propylene glycol, or if you are elderly. Do not use it on damaged skin (hemorrhagic skin diseases, eczema, infected lesions, burns, wounds), in the eyes, or on mucous membranes. Do not use it under an occlusive dressing. Adverse reactions may occur - sometimes local itching, redness, rash, scaling, eczema and dermatitis, contact dermatitis and erythema (red patches), and rarely photosensitivity; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature.
